offering_description.value: Provides software and outsourced operations for investment management, banking and insurance firms, letting them run portfolio accounting, trading, fund administration and compliance. Sells mainly through multi-year software licenses, subscriptions and managed services delivered on its own platforms and cloud.

primary_products.value: portfolio management software; accounting and fund administration software; trading and order management software; wealth management software; compliance software

primary_services.value: outsourced fund administration; middle- and back-office operations; transfer agency services; data and analytics; managed hosting

customer_segment.value: B2B: asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, banks, insurers, wealth managers, retirement plan providers

end_markets.value: financial services; asset management; banking; insurance; real estate

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring fees for software access and cloud-hosted platforms; licensing or royalties: perpetual and term software licenses; service fees: outsourced administration, operations and support services; transaction or usage fees: fees per account, transaction or data volume processed
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops financial software and cloud platforms, sold to financial institutions; service provider: runs outsourced back-office and fund administration operations for clients

geography_served.value: global: Clients across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: portfolio, accounting, trading, wealth and compliance software plus outsourced operations for financial firms

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to financial institutions; partners / resellers: channel and technology alliance partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: financial services and data privacy rules affect its outsourced operations and clients, such as SEC and GDPR requirements
